SCENE CONTEXT
Evening living room, medium shot. the woman (27, Filipino-American, warm golden-tan skin, long dark wavy hair with curtain bangs, white poplin shirt with cuffed sleeves, dark-indigo jeans, small gold hoops) leans over the back of the caramel corduroy sofa from behind, forearms on the backrest, smartphone in her right hand, looking down and to the right toward him (off-screen).

FORMAT MODE
One continuous shot, no cuts.

CAMERA
Fixed camera on a tripod, exactly the framing of the start image, no zoom, no pan, no handheld sway. Modern Korean sitcom look: clean, natural warm colors, evening indoor lighting with warm lamps and string lights, window dark navy, no film grain, no over-sharpening.

ACTION
0.0s to 0.5s: she looks down at him off-screen right. 0.5s to 2.3s: she says her line like it is obvious. 2.3s to 3.0s: a small shrug.

PERFORMANCE
Logical, kind, slightly smug. No exaggerated acting, no look at the camera.

AUDIO
Quiet living-room ambience only (soft refrigerator hum). No music, no notification sounds, no vibration, no door sounds.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Continue exactly from the start image. The woman keeps the same face, hair, glasses, clothes and position through the whole take. Same room, furniture, lamps and colors. No new people enter. No subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark.

DIALOGUE
The woman says in fluent Korean with a light Filipino-English accent and an English-like rising rhythm, bright and playful, logical, each word clear, falling: "여기선 못 하지. 오빠가 있잖아." She says only this one line and nothing else; no other words in any language. Natural delivery, visible lip-sync, mouth movements match every word, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
